notes: Business counts only when written under a producer code listed in Schedule A (clause 3.1).
Business placed through any residual market mechanism and all commercial lines are excluded (clause 3.2).
Eligible Written Premium of all member agencies is combined for qualification (clause 4.2).
Earned Premium and Incurred Losses are valued as of February 28, 2026 (clause 5.2).
No bonus is payable if the agency agreement is terminated before the payment date of March 31, 2026 (clause 6.3).
